title: Bundled practice catalog
description: Repository-managed practice definitions installed into the curated instance catalog.

$schema.description: Schema used by editors and CI to validate this catalog.

criteriaPreambles.description: Shared review instructions keyed by reviewed work type or a named specialization.

groups.description: Ordered practice groups; array order is the bundled display order.

group.description: A named group of related practices.

slug.description: Stable group identifier used for provenance and URLs.

description.description: Optional explanation of the group's purpose.

icon.description: Optional icon name supported by the admin interface.

color.description: Optional color name supported by the admin interface.

practices.description: Ordered practices in this group; array order is the bundled display order.

slug.description: Stable practice identifier used for provenance, findings, and URLs.

on.description: Occasions this practice is reviewed on. A bare signal name is shorthand for a binding on that signal reading the artifact kind's default evidence.

precomputeScript.description: Optional classpath resource containing TypeScript that prepares structured review context.

preamble.description: Optional named criteria preamble; defaults to the reviewed work type.

criteria.description: Markdown rules used by any reviewer and by Hephaestus when automated review is enabled.

whyItMatters.description: Optional developer guidance explaining the value of the practice.

whatGoodLooksLike.description: Optional developer guidance giving a concrete positive example.

holdsAs.description: One present-tense sentence naming what the developer keeps doing when this practice holds, shown on the practice profile beside a practice that stands as a strength, written without dashes. Read from the bundled catalog by slug, never copied into a workspace.

deliveryBehavior.description: How negative feedback from this practice is placed or deduplicated.
Declared feedback placement and co-occurrence choices for a practice.

summaryOnly.description: Show feedback in the summary instead of on a changed line.

overlapGroup.description: On issues, show only the first negative practice in this group.

redundantToSlug.description: When both practices are negative, show feedback from this preferred practice instead.

binding.description: One occasion this practice is reviewed on, and the evidence that review reads.

signals.description: Signals that occasion this review. All must share one artifact kind; that kind is what the practice reviews.

needs.description: Sources a review occasioned this way reads. Omit to read the artifact kind's default evidence.

sourceKind.description: Stable source identifier from the shipped source contract.

stance.description: REQUIRED: the claim reads it. EXHAUSTIVE: the claim asserts something is absent from it, so a partial capture cannot satisfy it. CONTEXTUAL: used if present, never fatal.

onDrafts.description: Whether an artifact still marked draft occasions this review. Defaults to false.

subject.description: Whose conduct a review occasioned this way judges, and therefore which person its observations are filed against. Defaults to AUTHOR. A practice about reviewing somebody else's work names REVIEWER; one about the act of merging names MERGER, reviewed only when the merger is the author the run is about.

appliesWhen.description: What must be in the work for this practice to have anything to judge. Decided from staged evidence before the practice is put to a model, so a practice whose subject is provably absent is not asked. Omit to apply to every artifact of this kind.

signalName.description: Vendor-neutral signal name, <domain>.<kind>.<signal>; its prefix is the artifact kind.

subject.description: A subject declaration: what has to be in a piece of work for a practice to have anything to judge about it, and the sentence to show a reader when it is not.

absentSays.description: Sentence shown wherever the resulting silence is explained, in the practice author's voice and phrased as a fact about the work, e.g. 'the change touches no dependency manifest or lockfile'.

anyOf.description: Shapes the subject may take. The subject is present when any one is found, and provably absent only when every one was decided and none was found, so adding a clause can only make the practice run more often.

subjectClause.description: One shape the subject may take. Exactly one of the three properties is stated; a clause nothing could settle leaves the practice running.

changedPathMatches.description: Globs matched against every path the change names, both sides of a rename. '*' does not cross a '/', '**' does, and a leading '**/' also matches zero segments so '**/pom.xml' finds a root pom.xml. Every other character is literal.

diffContains.description: Literal strings sought anywhere in the diff — added, removed or context — so that removing the last test in a file still counts as the subject being present. Literals rather than patterns: the declaration is operator-editable and is scanned over every diff of every review.

evidenceHasItems.description: A named evidence collection that must hold at least one entry. An empty collection settles the clause only when its source was captured whole.
